name: python-restx__flask-restx
behavioral_change: werkzeug v_old 2.0.3 to v_new 2.1.2 (2.1.2 is required because 2.2.x adds an unrelated interface break). werkzeug.wrappers.Request.json / Request.get_json on non-JSON content now raises (Request.on_json_loading_failed) instead of returning None.
downstream_effect: Resolving the argument location with getattr on the request triggers the new exception and the existing tests fail; one test with an unclean scoring basis is excluded from the scoring set.
reference_fix: Changes `Argument.source` in `flask_restx/reqparse.py` so that when a location is `"json"` or `"get_json"` the value is obtained via `request.get_json(silent=True)` instead of `getattr(request, location, ...)`, in both the single-location and multi-location branches.
